verdict.rationale: Unstructured's first-party docs describe the whole story. Partitioning produces document elements plus metadata in consistent JSON. Chunking then regroups those elements to fit embedding-model limits, with by-title, by-page, and by-similarity strategies that respect semantic boundaries. Embedding jobs output AI-ready JSON with vector embeddings, and this is available through the SDK, REST API, MCP server and workflows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of chunk quality and metadata fidelity.
